create_env: create Atari environments with DeepMind and PyTorch wrappers for evaluation
create_train_env: create infinite Atari training environments with DeepMind wrappers for A2C learning
create_agent: create an AtariAgent instance with a given model and number of actions
run_Experiment: run the A2C experiment with config for PongNoFrameskip-v4 Atari environment training
create_model_Experiment: create an ActionModel and CriticModel combined into a Model for Atari tasks
